helmet_front.why: helmet_front r2 is cut from the MASTER's pixels (no seam at rest). zone_px: search band around the registered helmet; palette_margin: a pixel is head only when its colour is nearer the head palette by this much (shell shading stays helmet); ink_px: outline within this distance of helmet colour is helmet; fill_reach_px: master pixels next to the helmet that head_no_helmet does not cover are kept so the stack has no hole; Ember: fill_reach_px 8 (at 30 the gap fill picked up strips of the far ear's fur under the brim); white_needs_enclosure: Ember's white fur and the shell's white highlights share one colour, so white is helmet only where the red shell encloses it
